215: function draftKey(id: string): string {
216:   return `workflow-lite.run-draft.${id}`
217: }

219: /** 草稿存在本地：关掉实例视图或切走再回来，接着改。 */
220: function readDraft(id: string): { edits: StateEdit[]; note: string } {
221:   try {
222:     const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(draftKey(id))
223:     if (raw === null) return { edits: [], note: '' }
224:     const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { edits?: unknown; note?: unknown }
225:     return {
226:       edits: Array.isArray(parsed.edits) ? (parsed.edits as StateEdit[]) : [],
227:       note: typeof parsed.note === 'string' ? parsed.note : '',
228:     }
229:   } catch {
230:     return { edits: [], note: '' }
231:   }
232: }
233: 
234: function writeDraft(id: string, edits: StateEdit[], note: string): void {
235:   try {
236:     if (edits.length === 0 && note === '') window.localStorage.removeItem(draftKey(id))
237:     else window.localStorage.setItem(draftKey(id), JSON.stringify({ edits, note }))
238:   } catch {
239:     // 尽力而为。
240:   }
241: }

515:         } else {

517:         }
518:         return null
519:       } finally {
520:         setSaving(false)
521:       }
522:     },
523:     [rpc, id, session, note, notify, saving, flash, t, load, onSaved, resetDraft],
524:   )
